info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Treasury Management API
info.description: The Corporate Treasury Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage their treasury operations. This endpoint allows users to submit treasury-related transactions, enhancing cash flow visibility and liquidity management. It is particularly useful for corporate treasurers and financial analysts who require timely and accurate execution of treasury processes. The API simplifies the integration of treasury functionalities into existing financial systems, ensuring more effective strategy implementation and risk management.
